tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find pieces in this store by words (e.g. 'wool sweater', 'cardigan', 'rust'), optionally filtered by department, size and maximum price. Empty query lists every piece.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything the product page says about one piece: price, sizes, colour, story and details, the supplier's size chart (garment measurements), delivery estimate, returns, customer reviews and the page to buy it on.

tools.name: store_policies
tools.description: Shipping, returns, privacy, terms or contact policy, in full, as published.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: The status of one order (preparing, shipped, delivered), its items, delivery estimate and tracking. Needs the 8-character order reference from the confirmation email and the email used at checkout.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product · Private data: store_policies · Public sink: track_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product · Private data: store_policies · Public sink: track_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
